pages.title: Biosafety Panel
pages.text: A sealed wall panel for a high-containment lab, easy to scrub and with nothing for a microbe to hide in. Found in the BSL-4 Field Stations of the Overworld. The Autoclave makes Sterile Packs with it; iron and quartz make more.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Bsl4 Field Station chests.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Sterile Pack.
